look: Ship's HUD trailer: one continuous camera flight through deep space with parallax stars and soft nebula; real AstraCore UI floats as chamfered HUD panels that unfold from orange signal squares; kinetic Barlow Condensed chapter lines; letterboxed, film grain. Story: PI setup is a chore everyone hates, AstraCore makes setting up fun, then keeps watch.

scenes.name: Cold open
scenes.desc: Dark space; a terminal types the name of a dreaded PI setup spreadsheet and its tabs of questions.

scenes.name: The spreadsheet
scenes.desc: Setup questions and spreadsheet cells fly past in depth; everybody hates setting up PI; it all implodes to one orange point.

scenes.name: The promise
scenes.desc: The point becomes an underline: what if setup was the fun part?

scenes.name: Meet AstraCore
scenes.desc: The mark grows from a point: meet AstraCore PI, a guided setup.

scenes.name: Your pilots
scenes.desc: Character cards fly in from depth with skills and colony slots read for you.

scenes.name: Your goal
scenes.desc: The guided setup panel: what do you want from PI; Balanced is picked.

scenes.name: A few questions
scenes.desc: The stepper runs through logins, area, products and selling, one answer each.

scenes.name: Your space
scenes.desc: A star map: the area you already fly and its drop-off light up.

scenes.name: Your plan
scenes.desc: The plan unfolds from the drop-off: income, hauling, slots and restarts, sized to your time.

scenes.name: Build it
scenes.desc: DalShooth templates matched to the plan fan out; a build checklist ticks off.

scenes.name: It keeps watch
scenes.desc: A planet approaches and its extractor links light up: then it keeps watch.

scenes.name: Next action
scenes.desc: The Operate Next up panel unfolds from a node; a callout locks onto the next action.

scenes.name: AstraCore PI
scenes.desc: Mark and wordmark land on a signal line; PI setup without the spreadsheet; address and credits.
